mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_order (order_sn, member_id, member_username, total_amount, pay_amount, pay_status, pay_type, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail_address, create_time) VALUES (#{orderSn}, #{memberId}, #{memberUsername}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverProvince}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverDistrict}, #{receiverDetailAddress}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oms_order WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM oms_order WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order SET pay_status = #{payStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE oms_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
